# Byteforms

All-in-one solution for form creation, submission management, and data integration.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/byteforms/.

## Actions

- **Create form**: Create a new form.
- **Delete Form**: Delete a form by its id.
- **Get all forms** (read-only): Fetch all forms created by the authenticated user.
- **Get Form By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific form using its id.
- **Get Form Responses** (read-only): Retrieve responses for a specific form with optional pagination and filtering.
